manor.note: 晚月庄 on the ground: the cobbled path from 绮云镇 (east) to the arch in the pale green wall; the forecourt before the red main door with its lanterns; the front garden of rare flowers and rocks (the 湘园 lies south of it, its own map); the main hall with its rosewood tables and screen, the reception room north of it; west of the hall the plum courtyard, the corridors round it (the punishment room behind the bronze door, the study and the stone-doored secret room on the west), the inner hall behind the 仪门 south-east of the courtyard; south through the 仪门 crossing to the dining halls and kitchen (east), the guest wing (west) and the rear hall behind its great door; round the rear hall the corridors to the east and west wings, the inner studies, the stairs up to the front tower, the inner hall and, behind the 垂花门, the women's passage to the changing room and the flower pool (and, south, the way into the secret rooms, their own map).

garden.note: 湘园, south of the front garden: the forecourt by the rockery pool, the moon gate in the bamboo fence, 翠嶂 under its willows with the 西府海棠; west the osmanthus garden and its pebble paths to the 紫翎小轩 and the farm cottages of 稻香榭 (their well and stone tablet); east the rockery tunnel to the vermilion bridge and the 暖香榭 on the east shore; in the middle the pond, its bridges and the 沁芳亭 on the water; the path between bamboo to the wooden back gate.
